messages:
anya: Heads up — noticed the /v1/ingest POST docs show error payload as {"error_message": "..."} but runtime returns {"error": {"message": "...", "code": 422}}. Python SDK is failing to parse the example response.
ben: Can you paste a quick curl + the actual response you saw?
anya: Sure:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/ingest -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"data": "..."}' -i
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{"error": {"message": "invalid format for field X", "code": 422}}
```
morgan: Yep that's the mismatch. The docs example is stale. Also noticed the request sample still uses `prefill: true` — we renamed that param to `prefetch` in the runtime months ago.
ben: I opened a docs PR to update the OpenAPI examples and the SDK snippet templates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521
docs-bot: PR created by ben: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521 — includes example response change + `prefill` -> `prefetch` in request samples.
anya: Two quick asks: 1) adjust all SDK examples (py/js) so they access `error.message` instead of `error_message`, 2) add a short migration note (Breaking changes) that `prefill` is now `prefetch` so integrators can update.
morgan: I'll update the PR: change response example to match actual runtime shape, add migration note, and run the docs linter. ETA today.
ben: @morgan can you also add a tiny code snippet showing the new error access pattern for the JS snippet? e.g. `if (resp.error) console.error(resp.error.message)`
morgan: good call — added the JS snippet and a small example JSON in the PR:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "invalid format for field X",
    "code": 422
  }
}
```
ben: Also we should regen the client SDKs once this lands — I'll take JS, Anya can you do Python?
anya: Yep I can handle the python SDK regen and publish a patch release after tests.
docs-bot: CI: docs-linter passed for PR #4521 — https://ci.redwood.ai/12345
morgan: PR merged. Preview site updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/ingest — examples now show `error.message` and `prefetch`.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll run a quick smoke test against the python client against staging to confirm parsing. Will update this thread with results.
anya: Quick follow-up — python smoke passed. Example now parses as expected. Closing loop.
